'''2007 Illinois State Championship Aaron Groth DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Groth]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' And the rest were crushed...
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
